key_insight: Continuous Lie point-symmetry generators can be recovered directly from sampled differential-equation data without symbolic determining equations or closed-form governing models.
engineering_relevance: Explicit symmetry generators can reveal geometric structure useful for model reduction and scientific machine learning.
method: Build a sampled determining operator on jet-space data using prolongation.
Apply sequential subspace restrictions to separate intrinsic generators from redundant, solution-dependent, and geometrically trivial directions.
Fit a fixed nonlinear dictionary linear in trainable coefficients, with a rank-stabilization preflight test under dictionary refinement.
evidence_signal: On a controlled benchmark, the method recovered all 11 represented intrinsic symmetry generators, reproduced their Lie brackets to numerical precision, and approximated a known generator beyond the training domain.
watch_item: Recovery is limited by the chosen dictionary; the preflight test flags cases where the represented symmetry algebra fails to stabilize under refinement.
paper_title: Data-driven discovery of intrinsic Lie point symmetries of differential equation systems
